@@ -15,7 +15,27 @@ written. Their source is `services/token-spend-report/` in the private
 2. refuses unless each extracted file equals its pinned SHA-256;
 3. copies the verified bytes to `/home/ubuntu/token-spend-report/scripts` as
    `ubuntu`, then reads every target back and refuses unless its SHA-256 equals
-   the pin.
+   the pin;
+4. installs the oneshot user unit `token-spend-quota-triggers.service` (no
+   `[Install]` section, no timer) and starts it only when `quota_triggers.py`,
+   `build_triggers.py` or `emit_spend_key.py` changed in this apply, or the unit
+   itself changed. The unit PUTs the Honeycomb triggers (idempotent by trigger
+   name) through `/usr/local/bin/with-livespec-env.sh`, which supplies
+   `HONEYCOMB_CONFIG_KEY_LIVESPEC`; the key is never in the unit or this repo;
+5. reads the live triggers back with `quota_triggers_check.py` (GET only) and
+   fails the play on any missing or differing trigger. Steps 4 and 5 are skipped
+   in check mode, so `just ansible-drift` never PUTs.

+scripts were installed, the next apply sees no change and does not retry it, but
+step 5 fails on the live difference: start it by hand with
+`systemctl --user start token-spend-quota-triggers.service` and read
+`journalctl --user -u token-spend-quota-triggers.service`.
+Known limits (independent second look, 2026-11-19): step 5 also runs on an unrelated re-apply, so a transient
+1Password or Honeycomb 5xx fails that play; the read-back is a subset match, so a live key the script does not set
+(for example `filter_combination`) is not reported; and two live triggers sharing one name are not told apart.

 origin, then bump the sha and the affected digests here in one PR. Do not edit a

+++ b/ansible/roles/token_spend_report/tasks/main.yml
@@ -16,6 +16,21 @@
       64-hex SHA-256 per script must be declared.
     success_msg: token-spend report route is complete
 
+- name: Look for the credential wrapper the trigger unit runs through
+  ansible.builtin.stat:
+    path: "{{ token_spend_report_env_wrapper }}"
+  become: false
+  register: token_spend_report_wrapper_stat
+
+- name: Require the credential wrapper
+  # The unit and the read-back get the Honeycomb configuration key only from
+  # this wrapper; without it the unit would fail at exec after every change.
+  ansible.builtin.assert:
+    that:
+      - token_spend_report_wrapper_stat.stat.exists
+    fail_msg: "{{ token_spend_report_env_wrapper }} is missing; the trigger unit has no credential path."
+    success_msg: the credential wrapper is present
+
 - name: Create a scratch directory on the control node
   ansible.builtin.tempfile:
     state: directory
@@ -101,6 +116,7 @@
   loop: "{{ token_spend_report_scripts | dict2items }}"
   loop_control:
     label: "{{ item.key }}"
+  register: token_spend_report_install
 
 - name: Read back installed token-spend script digests
   # A host read, not a copy result: the bytes visible at the live destination.
@@ -132,6 +148,106 @@
   loop_control:
     label: "{{ item.item.key }}"
 
+- name: Resolve the trigger unit owner's uid
+  ansible.builtin.getent:
+    database: passwd
+    key: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+  become: false
+
+- name: Create the user systemd unit directory
+  ansible.builtin.file:
+    path: "{{ token_spend_report_triggers_unit_dir }}"
+    state: directory
+    owner: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+    group: "{{ token_spend_report_group }}"
+    mode: "0755"
+  # As the owner, so a missing ~/.config or ~/.config/systemd is created owned by
+  # the user, not by root (second-look finding 4, 2026-11-19).
+  become: true
+  become_user: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+
+- name: Install the oneshot unit that applies the Honeycomb triggers
+  # Type=oneshot with no [Install] section and no timer: nothing starts it on
+  # a clock.  The credential comes from the wrapper at exec time; the unit
+  # holds no key.
+  ansible.builtin.copy:
+    dest: "{{ token_spend_report_triggers_unit_dir }}/{{ token_spend_report_triggers_unit }}"
+    owner: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+    group: "{{ token_spend_report_group }}"
+    mode: "0644"
+    content: |
+      [Unit]
+      Description=Apply the quota-guard Honeycomb triggers (plan token-spend-analysis, livespec-dev-tooling-caejh2)
+
+      [Service]
+      Type=oneshot
+      ExecStart={{ token_spend_report_env_wrapper }} -- {{ token_spend_report_python }} -I {{ token_spend_report_scripts_dir }}/quota_triggers.py
+  become: true
+  register: token_spend_report_unit
+
+- name: Reload the owner's user manager so it sees the unit
+  # Not in check mode: a drift run must change nothing.  A manager that is not
+  # running reads the unit directory afresh when it starts.
+  ansible.builtin.command:
+    argv: [systemctl, --user, daemon-reload]
+    removes: "/run/user/{{ ansible_facts.getent_passwd[token_spend_report_user][1] }}/systemd"
+  become: true
+  become_user: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+  environment:
+    XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: "/run/user/{{ ansible_facts.getent_passwd[token_spend_report_user][1] }}"
+  changed_when: true
+  when:
+    - not ansible_check_mode
+    - token_spend_report_unit is changed
+
+- name: Work out whether a script the trigger unit runs changed in this apply
+  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+    token_spend_report_triggers_changed: >-
+      {{ token_spend_report_install.results
+         | selectattr('changed')
+         | selectattr('item.key', 'in', token_spend_report_triggers_apply_scripts)
+         | list | length > 0 or token_spend_report_unit is changed }}
+
+- name: Apply the Honeycomb triggers because a script they run changed
+  # Only on a changed pin or unit, so an unchanged re-apply never PUTs.  The PUT
+  # is idempotent by trigger name.  `systemctl start` on a oneshot waits for the
+  # run and fails on a non-zero exit; the output is in
+  # `journalctl --user -u {{ token_spend_report_triggers_unit }}`.
+  ansible.builtin.command:
+    argv: [systemctl, --user, start, "{{ token_spend_report_triggers_unit }}"]
+  become: true
+  become_user: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+  environment:
+    XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: "/run/user/{{ ansible_facts.getent_passwd[token_spend_report_user][1] }}"
+  changed_when: true
+  when:
+    - not ansible_check_mode
+    - token_spend_report_triggers_changed | bool
+
+- name: Read the live Honeycomb triggers back against the pinned script
+  # Read-only: quota_triggers_check.py only GETs.  It runs on every real apply,
+  # so drift in the live triggers, or a unit run that did not take, fails the
+  # play instead of passing silently.  Not attempted in check mode, for the
+  # reason the digest read-back above is not: the host still holds the old bytes.
+  ansible.builtin.command:
+    argv:
+      - "{{ token_spend_report_env_wrapper }}"
+      - --
+      - "{{ token_spend_report_python }}"
+      - -I
+      - "{{ token_spend_report_scripts_dir }}/quota_triggers_check.py"
+  become: true
+  become_user: "{{ token_spend_report_user }}"
+  changed_when: false
+  register: token_spend_report_triggers_check
+  failed_when: token_spend_report_triggers_check.rc != 0
+  when: not ansible_check_mode
+
+- name: Report the live trigger read-back
+  ansible.builtin.debug:
+    msg: "{{ token_spend_report_triggers_check.stdout_lines }}"
+  when: not ansible_check_mode
+
 - name: Remove the control-node scratch directory
   ansible.builtin.file:
     path: "{{ token_spend_report_scratch.path }}"

+# 011 — quota_triggers.py oneshot unit and live read-back: design (2026-11-19)
+
+Item: livespec-dev-tooling-caejh2. Ruling: legacy-coordinator-agent, 2026-11-19 (option a, three conditions). Parent
+context: livespec-dev-tooling-jxyklc.
+
+## What reading the role and the scripts showed
+
+1. **The scripts have no read-only mode.** `quota_triggers.py` builds each trigger body inline inside `main()` and every
+   path ends in a POST or PUT. A read-back that "compares what the script would set" cannot be written without first
+   exposing the bodies. `build_triggers.py` is imported by it (`bt.call`, `bt.RECIPIENT`) and also PUTs on its own run.
+2. **So the change spans two repositories and bumps two pins.** vps-info owns the bytes (no Python gate there; the
+   livespec-dev-tooling gates reject them as written). The role pins them by commit sha and SHA-256. Order: vps-info
+   first, then the role pin, per the role's own HOST_VARS.md.
+3. **The units are not role-managed today.** The three `token-spend-*` units live in `~/.config/systemd/user/` on the
+   vps and the role installs only scripts. They were hand-installed. The new unit is therefore the role's first unit,
+   and it is user-scoped (it runs as `ubuntu` through `with-livespec-env.sh`, like `token-spend-fast.service`).
+4. **Existing units already show the credential pattern:** `ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/with-livespec-env.sh -- /usr/bin/python3 -I %h/token-spend-report/scripts/<script>`.
+   The new unit reuses it verbatim, so no key is stored in the unit or the repository.
+
+## Design
+
+- **vps-info PR (scripts):** in `quota_triggers.py`, move body construction into `desired()` returning `[(name, body)]`
+  (the `main()` loop and the inline `tenant Claude account low` and `quota guard quiet` puts all use it), keeping
+  behaviour identical. Add `quota_triggers_check.py`: for each `desired()` entry, GET the live trigger by name and
+  compare description, query, frequency, threshold, alert_type, recipients and disabled; print one line per trigger,
+  never the key; exit non-zero on any missing or differing trigger. Add a test with a fake `bt.call`.
+- **Role PR (livespec-dev-tooling), as built:** pin the changed `quota_triggers.py` plus `quota_triggers_check.py` and
+  `emit_spend_key.py` at vps-info 12cf60f0d6bd (vps-info#97, merged). Install `token-spend-quota-triggers.service`
+  (Type=oneshot, no `[Install]`, no timer; ExecStart through `with-livespec-env.sh`) into `~ubuntu/.config/systemd/user`.
+  The role starts it only when `quota_triggers.py`, `build_triggers.py` or `emit_spend_key.py` changed in that apply, or
+  the unit changed. After every real apply the role runs `quota_triggers_check.py` through the wrapper as a plain
+  command (stdout visible) and fails the play on any difference. Check mode starts nothing and skips the read-back, so
+  a drift run never PUTs. One deliberate change from the first sketch: no separate check unit, because a failed
+  oneshot start reports only "Job failed" and hides the DIFFERS lines the check prints.
+- **Credential probe:** value-free (`printenv HONEYCOMB_CONFIG_KEY_LIVESPEC | wc -c` through the wrapper), recorded on
+  the item, never echoed.
+- **Gates on the first live apply, not the merge:** one fresh independent subagent second look, time-boxed to 30
+  minutes, over the unit, the handler and the check. Then one deliberate committed apply, a read of the live
+  "token-spend tenant Claude account low" description through the configuration key, and a value-free hash recorded on
+  caejh2 and jxyklc.
+
+## Open risk to name
+
+`quota_triggers.py` imports `build_triggers`, which does `from emit_spend_key import HEARTBEAT_SOURCES` and reads
+`HONEYCOMB_CONFIG_KEY_LIVESPEC` at import. `emit_spend_key` is one of the unpinned sibling modules on the vps. The unit
+therefore depends on a file the role does not manage, which is the same gap qsa576 inventories. The check script has
+the same import. Pinning `emit_spend_key.py` is the smallest fix and belongs in the vps-info PR above if it is
+byte-identical to the vps copy; I will compare it over read-only ssh before deciding.
+
+## Reversal
+
+Remove the two units and the pins. Triggers already PUT stay in Honeycomb, unchanged.
